children: Canadian AI firm Cohere Inc. is in advanced discussions to raise between $2 billion and $3 billion, including financing from the Canadian government.

The financing would value the AI company at $20 billion, according to a Globe & Mail report on Friday, which cited people familiar with the matter. Should a deal happen, it would be the largest on record for a private Canadian startup.
The deal could close as early as next week, though timing could slip, according to the report. The German government is also in talks to participate.
Cohere didn't respond to a request for comment from the publication.
